findings.source_quote: “The executioner stripped his bound hands over his knees, placed a stick between his knees and arms”
findings.suggested_fix: Badilisha sehemu hiyo iwe: “Mnyongaji aliweka mikono yake iliyokuwa imefungwa juu ya magoti yake, akaweka fimbo kati ya magoti na mikono yake”
findings.translation_quote: “Mnyongaji alimvua nguo, akamfunga mikono juu ya magoti, akaweka fimbo kati ya magoti na mikono yake”
